meaning: Effort leads to success.
Cleanliness brings health and prosperity.
The patient will rule the world.
Education in youth is like an inscription on a stone.
The face is the index of the mind.
Patience is paramount.
Health is the greatest wealth.
What we've learned is a handful of sand, what we haven't is the size of the world.
Haste makes waste (or a task done calmly won't fail).
Make hay while the sun shines.
Those who work hard are the ones who rise.
Prevention is better than cure.
Think before you leap.
Time is gold.
Truth alone triumphs.
Do not go where you are not respected.
A healthy body is must for any life pursuit.
Patience is deeper than the ocean.
Money often matters more than character in the world.
Sow the seeds at the right time (Aadi month).
Build a dam before the flood comes (Prepare ahead).
Practice makes perfect.
Even the mightiest can make a mistake.
Like a nail in a green tree (Something firmly fixed in mind).
A city without a river is not lived in well.
Self-help is the best help.
Persistence can wear down even the toughest obstacles.
Be grateful to those who helped you until the end.
Wisdom is the best treasure.
Smile even in the face of adversity.
